title: Remove the duplicated/truncated KNOWN-DEFERRED block in tool/vision_find_pass.js

evidence.quote: - city subtitle still shows raw GeoNames code "NN" (the build SCRIPT is fixed; the cities.sqlite ASSET regen is
- add-track wizard step-count denominator branches (6 → 7 → 4) by path — this is INTENDED, pinned by TS-11 tests

why: The KNOWN template string (fed verbatim into every one of the 9 parallel agent prompts via briefFor at line 213) contains ~9 'KNOWN-DEFERRED' bullets stated twice back-to-back (lines 134-151 then 152-168). The FIRST copy is truncated mid-sentence at line 151 ('...the cities.sqlite ASSET regen is') and jumps straight into an unrelated bullet already stated earlier — only the second copy (line 167-168) completes the sentence ('...pending a GeoNames source download — known, do not re-flag.'). This is accidental content left over from appending an updated list without deleting the old one; it bloats every agent invocation's prompt with garbled, redundant text.
recommendation: Delete the first (truncated) copy of the KNOWN-DEFERRED bullet list, keeping the second, complete copy (which also has one bullet — the Hebrew-Terms-toggle-hidden note — that the first copy lacks).
acceptance_criteria: `grep -c "add-track wizard step-count denominator branches" tool/vision_find_pass.js` returns 1, not 2.
The KNOWN string contains no truncated sentences (each bullet's parenthetical closes).
